addSupportedToken(address).details: Add a new supported token with Aave integration

params.tokenAddress: Address of the token to add

returns.success: Whether the token was added successfully

borrowFromAave(address,address,uint256,u.details: Borrow tokens from Aave against deposited collateral for a specific user

params.interestRateMode: Interest rate mode (1 for stable, 2 for variable)
params.recipient: Address to receive the borrowed tokens

constructor.details: Initialize the contract with Aave integration

params._aavePoolAddressesProvider: Address of the Aave Pool Addresses Provider
params._tokenStorage: Address of the Token Storage contract

getATokenBalance(address,address).details: Get aToken balance for a specific token and user

params.tokenAddress: Address of the token to check

returns._0: Total aToken balance for this token and user

getTotalATokenBalance(address).details: Get total aToken balance for a specific token across all users

params.tokenAddress: Address of the token to check

returns._0: Total aToken balance for this token

returns.availableBorrowsBase: Amount available to borrow in base units
returns.healthFactor: Current health factor in ray units (1e27)
returns.totalCollateralBase: User's total collateral in base units
returns.totalDebtBase: User's total debt in base units

getUserDebt(address,address).details: Get user's debt information for a specific token

returns.totalDebt: Total debt across all interest rate modes

returns.healthFactor: Current health factor for this user (in ray units, 1e27)

initializeBaseTokens().details: Initialize the base tokens with their aToken addresses

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

params.amount: Amount to repay (use type(uint256).max for full repayment)
params.interestRateMode: Interest rate mode (1 for stable, 2 for variable)

setUserUseReserveAsCollateral(address,ad.details: Set token as collateral for a specific user

params.tokenAddress: Address of token to use as collateral
params.useAsCollateral: True if token should be used as collateral

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

updateAavePool(address).details: Updates the Aave Pool contract address (if it changes in future)

updatePoolDataProvider(address).details: Updates the Aave Pool contract address (if it changes in future)

withdrawFromAave(address,address,uint256.details: Withdraw tokens from Aave for a specific user

params.recipient: Address to receive the withdrawn tokens
